notes: CANDIDATE SUPPORT TOOLING. Host-side pure tests are required before live use.
Packet20 firmware accepts runtime kernel indices 0..27; this adapter maps exact retained effect IDs 220..247 to those indices.
Packet20 supports one volatile renderer-safe snapshot per boot. Never automatically retry a failed session.
After restore, the runner's second snapshot call returns the original immutable snapshot receipt only if firmware reports restoreVerified=true and diagnostic mode is disabled.
In-firmware packet20Same() is the authoritative exact restore check.
The pre-run intentional Matrix power cycle is excluded from diagnostic interpretation; the live sweep runner's uptime monotonicity guard detects any reboot during the sweep.
AUX physical underglow LEDs may remain disconnected for Packet20; the AUX controller itself should remain reachable for projection telemetry.
